[Murakami Co., Ltd.](https://www.murakami.co.jp/english/) is an industrial screen-printing and photosensitive materials manufacturer, not a health technology developer. You might be thinking of **Murata Manufacturing**, a Japanese electronics component maker that supplies miniaturized wireless modules, Bluetooth tech, and stretchable sensors for medical wearables, continuous glucose monitors (CGMs), and ECG smartwatches. [](https://www.murata.com/en-us/campaigns/medical)

- **Continuous Glucose Monitors (CGMs):** Coin-sized skin patches (like Abbott FreeStyle Libre or Dexcom) that track interstitial glucose without routine finger pricks. [](https://www.sermo.com/resources/wearable-devices-for-healthcare/)

- **Smartwatches & Wearable ECG:** Wrist-based devices (such as Apple Watch or Withings) offering on-demand single-lead ECG, heart rate, and blood oxygen tracking. [](https://builtin.com/articles/wearable-technology-in-healthcare)

- **Sleep Trackers & Remote Monitoring:** Gadgets like the Oura Ring or clinical patches transmitting real-time biometric data to cloud networks for remote patient oversight. [](https://www.boydcorp.com/applications/medical-wearables.html)

Are you looking for information on **specific medical hardware components**, a **particular brand of health wearable**, or do you need help with **remote patient monitoring setups**?
